_comment: Hazel, the GP Link outbound lead-calling agent on Retell. scripts/retell-setup.js builds the Response Engine from `llm` + config/retell/hazel-prompt.md and the Agent from `agent` (+ voice_id from state.json, webhook_url from APP_BASE_URL). Edit here, then run `node scripts/retell-setup.js update`. 2026-10-28: stt fast + no boosted keywords + responsiveness 1.0 (latency), contact memory on, KB attached, Cartesia fallback voice (Retell forbids fallback from the main voice provider). Retell offers only standard tier for claude-5.5-sonnet.

action.text: Hi, it's Hazel from GP Link, sorry I've missed you. You'd enquired with us about GP work in Australia. I'll try you again, or you can grab a time with us using the link we emailed. Speak soon, bye.

post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: How the call ended. booked = a consultation was booked on the call via the booking tool; link_sent = the booking link was sent instead; callback_requested = they asked to be rung back; not_interested = they declined; not_a_gp = not a doctor / not a GP; wrong_number = wrong person; already_booked = they had already booked; voicemail = voicemail or answering machine; no_answer = nobody spoke; unclear = a person spoke but none of the above clearly applies.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: If they asked to be called back, when, in their own words. Empty otherwise.

post_call_analysis_data.name: gp_status
post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether they are a fully qualified GP (gp), still in GP training (trainee), not a GP at all (not_a_gp), or it never came up (unknown).

post_call_analysis_data.name: timeframe
post_call_analysis_data.description: When they said they want to move to Australia, in their words. Empty if not discussed.
examples: in two years once the kids finish school

post_call_analysis_data.name: notes
post_call_analysis_data.description: One or two sentences a human recruiter needs before the consultation: family situation, preferred locations, concerns raised, questions left unanswered.
examples: Partner is a nurse, two kids, wants Queensland coast. Asked about school fees, not answered.
